Server.Name: Hospital Challenge
Server.Description:
Navezgane Hospital Challenge is a permadeath challenge mod for 7 Days to Die 3.2. You wake up in Navezgane Hospital infected with Voss-7 — a mutated strain of the Septdiurnal Virus, resistant to honey and antibiotics. It is killing you. The only cure is at Trader Jen's clinic, and the only way to reach her is the wrecked gyrocopter on the hospital roof.
Scavenge and craft 8 gyrocopter parts hidden throughout the building, hold the infection back with home-brewed suppressants, survive blood moons, and get out before the virus finishes the job. Leave the hospital grounds and what is waiting outside does not lose interest.
One life. One hospital. One chance.
FEATURES
Permadeath · Voss-7 virus with stage effects that lift again if you push it back down · 8-part gyro repair in a fixed order · 3-tier suppressant crafting · Custom loot bags · Six difficulty presets from Walk-In to Flatline · In-game ESC survival guide · End-of-run debrief page with a verifiable completion code · Eleven languages
SINGLE PLAYER ONLY
This version is not supported in multiplayer and should not be run on a dedicated server. The challenge itself is per-player and works, but the rest of the mod assumes one player. A co-op version is planned.
DIFFICULTY
Six presets, selected on the Basic tab of the New Game screen. Critical is the default and the way the mod is meant to be played. Walk-In exists so you can learn the building without it killing you.
RECOMMENDED SETTINGS
The presets set everything for you. Loot respawn is 5 days and the hospital will feel picked clean before then, which is intended.
EAC must be disabled.
